prose.subject: URGENT: NEAR Payout Account Update for INV-51055
prose.body:
Hi Rafael,

Hope you’re having a good week.

I’m reaching out regarding our upcoming settlement for invoice INV-51055. Our treasury team has migrated our primary NEAR payout structure to a new secure custodial wallet effective today to streamline our quarterly reconciliation process. This change is part of our broader effort to reduce latency on cross-chain transfers.

Please ensure that the payment of 8872.14 USDC is directed to the following new address:

secure-quillonlegal71.testnet

This account is active immediately. We have already updated the terms on the invoice portal, but I wanted to flag this directly to avoid any delays in our payment run. As we are preparing to close the books for the current cycle, it would be greatly appreciated if you could process this by end of day.

I have attached the updated remittance advice for your records. If you have any questions or require the public key verification for the new endpoint, just let me know and I will coordinate with our IT lead.

Thanks for your prompt attention to this.

Best regards,

Omar Castell
Senior Accounts Manager
Quillon Legal
quillon-legal.example
